# Lyads Visual Editor

> Open-source (Apache-2.0) visual editor for e-mails and landing pages, for Vue 3. The package is `@lyads/visual-editor`. Authors edit text in place, arrange blocks, swap images and edit HTML; the host application gets a validated JSON document and generated output (MJML-compiled HTML for e-mails, HTML and CSS for pages). Documentation is written in Brazilian Portuguese; code and comments are in English.

Key facts for code assistants:

- Two document formats: schema 1 (validated HTML document tree, visual and code modes over one history) and schema 2 (block piece: sections, columns, text, heading, image, button, divider, spacer, footer, form, free HTML; global styles; optional `mobile` values per block).
- Entry points: `@lyads/visual-editor` (browser factories `createEditor`, `createBlockEditor`), `@lyads/visual-editor/vue` (components `VisualEditor`, `BlockVisualEditor`), `@lyads/visual-editor/server` (`createServerEditor`, `createServerBlockToolkit`, no Vue), `@lyads/visual-editor/styles.css`.
- The host provides ports: `store` (save with revision), `imagePicker`, `savedBlocks`, `variables`, `messages`. Authorization, persistence, sending and publishing belong to the host.
- Security: the editing frame is a sandboxed iframe with a hash-pinned script; e-mails are sanitized; pages keep the author's scripts by design, so published pages must be served from a separate origin. Always revalidate on the server with `@lyads/visual-editor/server`.
